features.name: Local-First Desktop Command Center
features.summary: Runs Khaos Nexus as a standalone Windows operations platform.
features.description: Brings Discord automation, game-server control, D&D campaign management, modules, updates, diagnostics, and local configuration into one desktop application. Sensitive values remain protected through Windows secure storage.

features.name: Module Center and Local Recovery
features.summary: Lets the local desktop owner enable, disable, recover, and safely gate application modules.
features.description: Includes dependency-aware module switching, Disable All, Safe Mode, validated-module recovery, migration notes, and local recovery controls that remain available when Discord is offline or misconfigured.

features.name: Startup Guard, Watchdog, and Recovery
features.summary: Detects failed or unresponsive launches and presents a usable recovery path.
features.description: Uses serialized startup, visible-interface health checks, renderer monitoring, retained watchdog state, software-renderer compatibility, and recovery diagnostics instead of leaving the application frozen.

features.name: Windows Installer, Portable Build, and Updates
features.summary: Ships installable and portable Windows builds with a protected update flow.
features.description: Supports installer and portable executables, updater metadata, checksums, mandatory pre-update backups, retryable installation, and an always-visible in-app update center.

features.name: Supervised Discord Bot Runtime
features.summary: Starts, monitors, configures, and recovers Discord bots from the desktop application.
features.description: Includes spawn-confirmed process supervision, slash-command support, live configuration updates, operator access controls, synchronized runtime status, and error reporting.

features.name: Discord Studio and Server Automation
features.summary: Builds and manages Discord-facing tools without manually recreating every server element.
features.description: Supports Discord Studio workflows, role menus, category and channel automation, module-aware commands and buttons, routed logs, and persistent server panels.

features.name: Privacy-Safe Status and Queue Panels
features.summary: Publishes persistent game-server information without exposing protected connection data.
features.description: Provides live server status, player summaries, queue information where supported, and refresh controls while excluding credentials, IP addresses, and platform identifiers from public output.

features.name: ARK and Generic RCON
features.summary: Connects to ARK and other compatible servers through guarded RCON operations.
features.description: Supports status checks, announcements, player visibility, saves, moderation, schedules, and adapter-based command handling without exposing raw credentials to the interface.

features.name: Palworld REST and RCON
features.summary: Combines Palworld REST capabilities with RCON-backed administration.
features.description: Provides typed server status, connected-player operations, announcements, save and shutdown workflows, Discord delivery, and stable redacted adapter errors.

features.name: Rust WebRCON
features.summary: Adds dedicated Rust server administration through WebRCON.
features.description: Includes vanilla-safe status, players, saves, announcements, moderation, Discord status and queue panels, and Owner-only raw console access.

features.name: Encrypted Pterodactyl Hosting Control
features.summary: Controls hosted servers through the Pterodactyl Client API without exposing API keys to the renderer.
features.description: Discovers hosted servers, reads resource state, and provides guarded start, restart, stop, and Owner-confirmed emergency kill actions through encrypted credentials and short-lived action tokens.

features.name: Cross-Server Players and Moderation
features.summary: Shows connected players across selected servers and centralizes guarded moderation.
features.description: Supports game, server, and player search; reason-required kicks; Owner-confirmed bans; protected identifiers; local action history; and short-lived moderation tokens.

features.name: Recurring Server Scheduler
features.summary: Automates warnings, saves, shutdowns, restarts, and recovery checks.
features.description: Includes countdown broadcasts, save-before-shutdown protection, game-specific safe shutdowns, provider restart verification, cancellation, interrupted-job recovery, Discord reports, and execution history.

features.name: Typed Game Adapter SDK
features.summary: Provides a consistent extension layer for adding supported games.
features.description: Uses explicit capability manifests, guarded destructive-action policies, stable redacted errors, bounded protocol fixtures, and shared bridges for Palworld REST, ARK and generic RCON, and Rust WebRCON.

features.name: Satisfactory Dedicated-Server Adapter
features.summary: Extends the shared adapter system to Satisfactory's dedicated-server API.
features.description: Active validation covers typed server operations, capability reporting, safe administrative actions, and integration with the shared Nexus status and control surfaces.

features.name: D&D Campaign Workspace
features.summary: Manages complete campaigns from the desktop app and approved Discord resources.
features.description: Stable workflows cover campaigns, members, sources, characters, quests, sessions, attendance, encounters, combatants, deterministic initiative, NPCs, locations, factions, loot, licensed content metadata, homebrew revisions, secure dice history, registered-bot grants, bindings, and persistent campaign panels.

features.name: D&D Content Catalog and Character Imports
features.summary: Adds verified free-content packs, Homebrew sources, and reviewable character imports.
features.description: The beta channel includes signed catalog validation, explicit Owner-controlled SRD package installation, source provenance, Khaos Nexus and generic JSON character imports, collision protection, and import review before saving.

features.name: Live Campaign Maps
features.summary: Adds uploaded or locally generated maps with persistent campaign markers.
features.description: The beta channel supports validated PNG, JPEG, and WebP uploads, deterministic local generation, pan and zoom, square or hex grids, party and campaign markers, GM-hidden data, normalized coordinates, and map snapshot export.

features.name: Advanced NPC Builder and Encounter Integration
features.summary: Expands NPC records into reusable narrative and combat-ready campaign tools.
features.description: The beta channel adds structured identity, personality, relationships, optional combat statistics, deterministic generation, import and export, reveal controls, encounter insertion, explicit stat synchronization, and featured-boss support.

features.name: Persistent Discord Encounter Panels
features.summary: Turns active encounters into live Discord combat panels with secure turn actions.
features.description: The beta channel adds one persistent message per encounter binding, boss and party health presentation, initiative updates, repairable panel records, DM-configured roll buttons, stale-action rejection, privacy enforcement, and audited DM controls.

features.name: Backups, Monitoring, and Support Bundles
features.summary: Captures actionable diagnostics while keeping secrets out of logs and exports.
features.description: Includes verified local backups, rolling breadcrumbs, unclean-shutdown detection, retained AppData logs, stale-health cleanup, redacted support bundles, and optional HTTPS diagnostics delivery.

features.name: Standalone Installer Diagnostics
features.summary: Provides installer-first troubleshooting before the main interface has to load.
features.description: Includes the dedicated Khaos Nexus Diagnostics launcher, startup environment checks, portable sidecar reporting, offline guidance, support-bundle creation, and clearer recovery paths for installation or launch failures.

features.name: Android Companion and Mobile Gateway
features.summary: Preserved but excluded from active production and desktop release scope by Owner directive.
features.description: Existing certificate-pinned HTTPS, Owner-approved pairing, signed-request, replay-protection, revocation, and Android Keystore work is preserved. APK publication, real-device testing, feature/toolchain repair, and Mobile Gateway activation remain prohibited until a new architecture decision explicitly resumes production.

features.name: Unified Desktop Interface System
features.summary: Consolidates the desktop and D&D interface into one responsive, accessible design system.
features.description: The planned refresh will unify navigation, cards, forms, dialogs, status presentation, responsive behavior, keyboard access, Windows scaling, and D&D workspace layouts without replacing working application contracts.

features.name: Release History and Safe Rollback
features.summary: Adds a Settings-based release history with protected rollback controls.
features.description: The planned update center will show the latest compatible Windows releases, distinguish beta and stable labels, create a verified backup, confirm the exact target, validate release assets, and record rollback history.

features.name: Shared Bot Onboarding and Bring Your Own Bot
features.summary: Makes one shared multi-server Nexus bot the default while preserving an advanced custom-bot path.
features.description: The default onboarding flow will connect communities to the managed Nexus bot. Advanced users will be able to supply their own Discord application and token for separate branding or isolation.

features.name: Remote D&D Player Experience
features.summary: Explores a secure remote player view for approved campaign information and live maps.
features.description: Any browser or remote-player experience requires a separate architecture decision for authentication, hosting, privacy, transport, and player-safe projections before implementation.

features.name: Additional Game Adapters
features.summary: Expands the Nexus through the typed adapter SDK as reliable server APIs become available.
features.description: Future adapters will reuse the same capability, permission, status, scheduling, moderation, and redaction contracts instead of introducing one-off control paths.
